v0.1.0.description:
# Voidloop Archipelago v0.1.0!
## Fixes
- Fixed a race condition that caused saves to fail to load when connected to a remote server.
## New features
- "Leversanity" option, one check per lever up to floor 20. Additional "Exits are levers" option to make any exit trigger the check.
- Viewing an upgrade in the shop now also scouts it as a hint for other players to see.

## NOTICE
- Pycharm, being pycharm, added a random import statement to my code which broke things silently. If you downloaded the apworld before this message was added, download it again!
